name: Wednesday Night Wild

date.source: The write-up's own dateline reads "May 21, 2003" (a Wednesday); the broadcast opens in Glasgow, Scotland, and the booth announces the start of a European tour.

notes: Names no arena. A young woman on Derceto's arm, police officers, a security guard, a boy fan, a priest and a man in a blond wig and walker billed as the Franchise appear unnamed. Matt Helms does not appear.

matches.note: Billed as Venom against Mad Max; Venom has been released, so a referee calls the bell for Max and Blackhorn. Max drives Blackhorn head first onto a barbed-wire bat with his running DVD; no count follows, no winner is named, and EMTs take Blackhorn away.

matches.title: chz-hardcore
matches.note: Dynamo Dragon brings the weapons and swings a chair; Zen hits the Windcutter and the three count: "Zen wins!"
Xear hits the Xear Drive for the three count: "Xear wins!"

matches.title: chz-tag-team
matches.note: The return match for the Tag Team titles, billed Heaven and Hell against the AAOD. Pfister tosses the cane, pulls the foot to the rope and hits Archangel with the Pop Rock Shock; Lucifer is pulled on top of Archangel for the three count, and the AAOD keep the titles.
Soze and Wild Dog beat Chazy down with a chair and a Big Bite in the tree of woe; MacPhereson arrives, drives them from the ring and helps Chazy out. No count and no winner.
Rossi hits Game Over and the referee counts three: "1... 2... 3..." Rage's Alpha title is not at stake; he had come out with it draped over his shoulder.

matches.title: chz-heavyweight
matches.note: MacPhereson knocks out the referee and a second referee counts his pin: "MacPhereson does it! He's the new World Champion!" Keyser Soze rules that the match was booked with one referee and that the count does not stand, and the first referee raises Manback's hand; Manback retains.
